caption: The drawing depicts a single, structured handbag centered on an off-white or light beige background. The handbag is predominantly brown and rectangular in shape, with slightly rounded top edges. It features an ornate, intricate floral or damask-like pattern on its surface, rendered in darker and lighter shades of brown that give the impression of embossed or textured fabric. The bag has a short, sturdy handle at the top, also brown with the same pattern, attached to the bag with metallic clasps. The frame of the bag is a different shade of brown, darker and smoother, and it includes a gold-toned metal clasp with a lock mechanism at the top center. The handbag is depicted with careful shading that gives it a three-dimensional appearance, and the background remains plain, with no additional objects or decorations present. There is a small, handwritten signature and some letters in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Satchel
